He plays the [[power forward (basketball)|power forward]] and [[center (basketball)|center]] positions. Motiejūnas is projected by various sources to be a lottery pick in the [[2011 NBA Draft]].[http://www.draftexpress.com/nba-mock-draft/2010/ DraftExpress.com: Mock Draft.] ==Pro career== Motiejūnas began his career playing with the youth team [[Žalgiris-Arvydas Sabonis school|Arvydas Sabonis School]] of [[Kaunas]].[http://www.euroleague.net/competition/players/showplayer?pcode=LCZ Donatas Motiejunas: Miscellaneous] He made his professional debut with the [[BC Žalgiris|Žalgiris Kaunas]] in a [[Baltic Basketball League|Baltic League]] game against the [[ASK Riga]]. He scored 15 points in 22 minutes.[http://www.krepsinis.net/players.php?user_id=72303 Krepsinis.net - Donatas Motiejūnas.] Motiejūnas helped Žalgiris Kaunas win a Baltic Championship, a [[Lithuanian Basketball League|Lithuanian Championship]] and a Lithuanian Cup. He averaged 5.6 points in 10.1 minutes per game in the Baltic League.[http://basketpedya.com/Acc002InfJug.php?idjug=78690 Donatas Motiejunas Player Profile At basketpedya.com] He signed with the [[BC Aisčiai-Atletas|Aisčiai-Atletas]] in 2008. With Aisčiai-Atletas, he averaged 19.9 points and 7.0 rebounds in 29.3 minutes per game and he scored a season-high 29 points in a Lithuanian League game against [[KK Nevėžis|Nevėžis]] on March 22, 2009.[http://www.krepsinis.net/user_seasonstats.php?user_id=72303&season_id=592 Donato Motiejūno sezono statistika] He moved to the [[Lega A|Italian League]] club [[Pallacanestro Treviso|Benetton Treviso]] in August 2009.[http://www.interperformances.com/basket/news_detail.php?id=336 Interperformances.com Another great signing by Benetton: Donatas Motiejunas.] There, he got off to a great start, scoring 18 and 21 points in two [[Friendly match|friendly matches]] against other European clubs. In 2011, Motiejūnas won the [[Eurocup Basketball Awards|Eurocup Rising Star]] award after helping his team [[Pallacanestro Treviso|Treviso]] reach the [[ULEB Eurocup|Eurocup]] [[Eurocup Basketball 2010–11 Final four|2010-11 Final Four]], averaging 10.9 points, 5.6 rebounds, 0.9 steals, and 4.4 fouls drawn per game.[http://www.eurocupbasketball.com/ulebcup/home/news/i/84189/3735 Motiejūnas Eurocup Rising Star.] ==Lithuanian national team== {{MedalTableTop}} {{MedalCountry|{{LTU}}}} {{MedalSport | Men's [[Basketball]]}} {{MedalCompetition|[[FIBA Europe Under-18 Championship|FIBA European U-18 Championship]]}} {{MedalSilver| [[U18 European Championship Men 2008 Division A|2008 Greece]] | [[Lithuania national basketball team|National Team]]}} {{MedalCompetition|[[FIBA Europe Under-20 Championship|FIBA European U-20 Championship]]}} {{MedalBronze| [[2009 FIBA Europe Under-20 Championship|2009 Greece]] | [[Lithuania national basketball team|National Team]]}} {{MedalBottom}} Motiejūnas was a part of the Lithuanian Under-16, Under-18, and Under-20 junior national teams. With Lithuania's junior national teams, he played at the: 2006 [[FIBA Europe Under-16 Championship]], both the 2007 and 2008 [[FIBA Europe Under-18 Championship]]s, the [[FIBA Under-19 World Championship 2009|2009 FIBA Under-19 World Championship]], and the 2009 [[FIBA Europe Under-20 Championship]]. He led Lithuania's junior national team to the silver medal at the [[U18 European Championship Men 2008 Division A|2008 Under-18 Championship]]. Despite losing to Greece's junior national team in the gold medal game, he was named the [[MVP]] of the tournament, after averaging 18.2 points, 10.2 rebounds and 1.8 blocks per game.[http://www.fibaeurope-u18men.com/en/Default.asp?coid={98D17BE2-71B2-4FDD-8B9A-F374B785E068}&articleMode=on Motiejunas MVP, Two Greeks In All-Tournament Team.] At the [[FIBA Europe Under-20
